$comment: forge per-project config (orchestrator reads this; preflight reads .forge/quality_gate_cmd). The default quality gate is the FAST, deterministic, creds-free OFFLINE unit suite scoped to the fork's net-new packages (release + taskagent) — NOT the live TF_ACC acceptance tests (those need a PAT + are 120m-timeout, so they run as sharp per-WI gates / operator confirmation, never as the project default). This pairing is the project-scoped fix for the 2026-05-23 dogfood false-pass (brain: themes/2026-05-23-dogfood-cycle-false-pass-gate.md).
$ci_gate_comment: The project's FULL CI verification — mirrors the GitHub workflows (golint + terrafmt + unit-test). A 'make CI green' / quality initiative MUST use this as its per-WI quality_gate_cmd (NOT a narrow lint-only proxy), so forge's own gate goes red until CI is genuinely green. `make test` = gofmt-check + `go test ./...` (whole module, incl. provider_test.go resource-count). Auto-fixers for the formatting checks: `make fmt` (gofmt) + `make terrafmt`.
ci_gate: make test && golangci-lint run ./... && make terrafmt-check
$ci_fix_cmd_comment: The project's auto-formatters, applied best-effort before ci_gate runs so the PR is fmt-clean: `make fmt` (gofmt) + `make terrafmt` (HCL in docs/examples). Mirrors the formatting checks ci_gate enforces.
$ci_gate_unset_env_comment: Env vars STRIPPED before ci_gate/ci_fix_cmd run, so the final CI delivery gate mirrors GitHub CI (a clean env) regardless of the cycle env. The serve env sets TF_ACC=1 so per-WI live-acceptance gates run; without stripping it here, `make test` would run the WHOLE live acc suite (env-dependent failures GitHub never sees, because GitHub runs make test without TF_ACC → acc tests skip → green). See forge contract A3.
$acceptance_gate_comment: Live-acceptance-WI requirement (contract C7). betterado behaviour can only be proven against live ADO, so every initiative MUST include ≥1 work item whose quality_gate_cmd targets the acceptance suite (path contains `acceptancetests`). The PM phase HARD-FAILS the cycle if no such WI is emitted — this closes the INIT-2 gap where a resource shipped with no live-acc test. The live test runs as that WI's own per-WI gate (TF_ACC + PAT from the serve env).
$acceptance_gate_requires_env_comment: TF_ACC must be set for a live-acc gate to actually run — without it, `resource.Test` SKIPS and `go test` prints `ok pkg 0.00s`, which the dev-loop's no-work scan can't catch (it looks like a pass). Listing it makes the dev-loop ERROR a live-acc WI gate whose env lacks TF_ACC, instead of false-passing. Added after the daemon ran INIT-3/4 cycles without TF_ACC and shipped unverified resources (2026-06-06).
$standing_work_item_acs_comment: Static testing invariants forge appends to EVERY work item (contract A2). Encodes the two-gate model as standing ACs so it no longer depends on per-WI PM judgment. The dev-loop must satisfy both; the reviewer must confirm both.
standing_work_item_acs: Live acceptance: the change is exercised by a TF_ACC acceptance test against real ADO — `terraform apply` → assert the object via the provider read → mandatory idempotency re-plan (`ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false`) → clean `destroy`. New resource/data-source ⇒ a new `TestAcc*`; change to an existing one ⇒ an updated `TestAcc*`.

CI-equivalent (push-green): the same checks GitHub runs must pass — `make test` (gofmt + whole-module `go test`, NO TF_ACC) + `golangci-lint run ./...` + `make terrafmt-check`. The production resource `.go` carries NO build tag; only `_test.go` files carry `//go:build`; `provider_test.go`'s resource-count list includes any new resource.

demo.$shape_comment: `harness` is the creds-free FLOOR (offline unit run, always available). betterado is NOT a no-web-UI project — it stands up real resources in a live ADO org (creds in secrets.env) visible via the REST API AND the dev.azure.com portal. The richer demo is LIVE EVIDENCE — terraform apply → API GET + portal screenshots → destroy — codified in the ado-demo skill. The forge demo phase should compose that skill; the shape vocab needs a 'live external system + portal screenshots' option (tracked in forge known-gaps).
